method: Every page rendered with the documents skill render_docx.py and inspected as a full page PNG. The reviewed PDF is the retained deliverable.

page_reviews.observations: Title, explicit reconstruction status, centered assembly image, design table and 10 N scope are readable; no clipping.
Bracket dimensions and labels are readable; geometry table remains on one page; both-end reconstruction note is complete.
Material references and three rounded-section equations render in full; superscripts, subscripts and values are legible.
All beam stress/deflection radicals and fractions render fully; corrected torsion-area definition and current 0.633310 MPa result are visible.
Chamfered-plug, plate and contact equations render completely; local wall stress and assumption limits are legible.
Anchor equations display explicit R multiplied by eccentricity e, with no real-part glyph; capacities, interaction and sleeve limitations are visible.
Both-end OCC fit results and the two physical/tolerance BLOCKED rows are readable; no split or clipped table rows.
Full directional-envelope equation, two real 3D bracket stress fields and the three-mesh results table are readable.
Centered beam stress figure, two-mesh result table, all convergence rows, equilibrium summary and retention scope fit on one page.
Five exact purchased catalogue identifiers, supplier hyperlinks, historical price basis and separate-currency totals are readable.
CI paths, functional self-test status, four literal python3 commands and full requirement group table are visible without overflow.
Physical qualification actions, all 14 supplier links, two method links and the release decision are visible and readable.

math_render_fixes: Inserted empty degree nodes required for hidden-degree OMML radicals.
Displayed the anchor product R times eccentricity e explicitly to prevent real-part glyph substitution.
